{{Quote|Chewbacca went on to become a soldier in the New Republic. He aided in Kashyyyk's liberation after the Battle of Endor.|[[Ralrracheen]]|<ref name="AC I">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>}}
The '''Liberation of Kashyyyk''', also known as the '''Battle of Kashyyyk''', was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], occurring eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It saw the deaths of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Hindane Darcc]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Peccati Syn]], as well as the liberation of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|It all began with a call for help: the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk was being overrun, and its cities demolished. The proud warrior race swallowed its pride and called their closest Rebel connection - Chewbacca. Unable to convince the Alliance to send a strike force, Han and Chewie traveled alone to the forest world, unsure of what they might find.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Battlegrounds" />}}
[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Hindane Darcc]], seeing the native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] as an obstacle to complete control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], hired the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Pekt]] to round up the Wookiees for shipment to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. The [[Government Tree]] and nearby [[Kepitenochan/Legends|Kepitenochan]] were quickly [[Devastation of Kashyyyk|devastated]]. Thousands of Wookiees were captured or killed within the first few days. In desperation, [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] contacted his son [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who was unable to convince the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to send assistance<ref name="Battlegrounds" /> eight months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Battle==
===Setbacks===
{{Quote|The Imperial communications jammers were working overtime to keep any signal to the Rebellion completely scrambled. It was too dangerous to try and break the Imperial blockade with the Falcon, so Han hit on the brilliant plan of taking out the jammers himself.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Battlegrounds" />}}
[[File:Kepitenochan_Government_Tree.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Han Solo and Chewbacca after rebuilding the Government Tree in Kepitenochan.]]
[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and Chewbacca, arriving on Kashyyyk, attacked several groups of Trandoshans and freed a group of Wookiees that retook Kepitenochan, only to find the city heavily damaged and only one survivor: [[Weebacca]]. Together, they rebuilt the [[Government Tree]] and guarded it against multiple Imperial attacks from an [[Imperial River Base|Imperial base]] nearby. In doing so, the Wookiees reunited under the monument. However, they still could not contact the Alliance with signal jammers blocking their transmissions.<ref name="Battlegrounds" />

Betraying the Wookiee resistance, Weebacca told Solo and Chewbacca that the communications jammers were in [[Okikuti]]. Upon entering the city, they realized it was a trap, as Darcc's forces advanced on the Okikuti's gates while there was no exit. They cut through the trees to the nearby river and built sea ships to escape to [[Chenachochan]]. Destroying several Imperial sea frigates, they stole Imperial walkers from [[Tunnatutikan]] and met up with [[Shoran]]. Together, they destroyed the signal jammers<ref name="Battlegrounds" /> with the help of Imperial equipment captured from the [[Imperial Depot]]<ref name="100% completion" /> and four [[Cruiser (Wookiee)|Cruisers]]. They were then able to send a transmission to the Rebel Alliance, which was received by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="Battlegrounds" />

===Liberation===
[[File:WeebaccaKilledByChewbacca-SWGB.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Weebacca is killed by Chewbacca.]]
{{Quote|Between Shoran and Chewie, the plan was obvious: The Imperial Moff must be ousted for Kashyyyk to be truly free. The Trandoshan slavers would never get another foothold under a strong Wookiee government, and that meant completely destroying a heavily-guarded Imperial Fortress. A small band of resistance fighters against the might of the Empire.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Battlegrounds" />}}
Liberating the rest of [[Chenachochan]], the Wookiees<ref name="Battlegrounds" /> captured an Imperial airbase and gained the support of the [[Ittummi]] [[Berserker]]s.<ref name="100% completion" /> Darcc's palace was destroyed by the united Wookiee Army and the traitor Weebacca was killed by Chewbacca. However, Darcc and Pekt escaped in a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] full of Wookiee prisoners.<ref name="Battlegrounds" />

===Battle of the Avatar Orbital Platform===
{{Quote|I happened to be monitoring the Alliance coded frequencies and I picked up my buddy’s distress call. After alerting Luke Skywalker and Rogue Squadron, I flew to Kashyyyk, only to find the Falcon, left abandoned in a forest clearing. I hopped in and we blasted off to the Avatar Orbital Platform, praying we weren’t too late to help.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Battlegrounds" />}}
[[File:DarccPektEscape1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darcc and Pekt escape Kashyyyk with a cargo hold full of Wookiees.]]
The Wookiees, led by Chewbacca and Solo, flew to the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]] and with the help of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], they rescued Attichitcuk with the Wookiee captives, killed Moff Darcc and the Trandoshan slaver Pekt, and finally, blew the main reactor of the facility.<ref name="Battlegrounds" />

The [[New Republic Third Fleet|New Republic Third Battle Group]] also fought in the battle under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] left from [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] space and fought [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Peccati Syn]]. [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan agents]] sabotaged two of Syn's [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruisers]]. The agents also impersonated aids of Admiral [[Treuten Teradoc]], who promised reinforcements to Syn from the [[Greater Plooriod sector/Legends|Greater Plooriod sector]]. Ackbar's [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] and Captain [[Verrack/Legends|Verrack's]] [[Maria (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Maria'']] caught Syn's flagship, the [[Silooth (Star Destroyer)|''Silooth'']] in a crossfire and destroyed its [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] in a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] barrage.<ref name="Warfare" /> Syn was killed when his ship was vaporized due to his underestimating Ackbar's tactics.<ref name="NEC" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|At any rate, Kashyyyk was free, after a long nightmare under the Empire and the Trandoshan slavers. Chewie received a hero’s welcome, and I caught Han smiling proudly at him.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Battlegrounds" />}}
Following Kashyyyk's liberation, the Imperials abandoned the spice planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. Chewbacca, Solo, Skywalker, and Calrissian agreed to go there and [[Liberation of Kessel|rescue]] all the slaves there.<ref name="Battlegrounds" /> Rogue Squadron and the Third Fleet then planned a [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|raid]] on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]],<ref name="Warfare" /> which resulted in the fall of the planet to the New Republic.<ref name="RS:ES">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: In the Empire's Service]]''</ref>

Admiral Ackbar privately admitted that the fleet's victory in the liberation was due to the Bothan's assistance.<ref name="Warfare" />

Following Chewbacca's [[Destruction of Sernpidal|death]] early in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Ralrracheen]] mentioned Chewbacca's participation in the liberation in his eulogy during his [[Funeral of Chewbacca|funeral]].<ref name="AC I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Liberation of Kashyyyk was first mentioned in the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', written by Timothy Zahn. It was first shown in the Chewbacca campaign of the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The [[2002]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''{{'s}} entry on Admiral Ackbar first named the conflict as the Battle of Kashyyyk.

An [[Rescue at Jundland Station|optional mission]] occurs if the player used the cheats "forcesight" and "forceexplore" to explore the map and the player directs attention to the desert area to the eastern corner. In it, two individuals are near the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]], while the Naboo queen is held captive by Tusken Raiders near Jundland Station. The player can easily complete the mission by summoning Simon the Killer Ewok, which eventually culminates in a duel with Darth Maul upon returning to the ship.
